_why: M2 deep-dive end-state. Arithmetic only, state-tolerant, no cluster. Run after labs/m2/checks.json from the learner tree: (cd labs && node ../scripts/run-checks.mjs m2/deep-dive.checks.json).

checks.describe: the paged-block calculator exits 0, prints the assumptions header, a block count and a fragmentation figure
checks.run:
sh -c 'o=$(bash m2/kv-blocks.sh m2/inputs/models/qwen2.5-7b-instruct.conf m2/inputs/vram-scenario.conf); echo "first=$(printf "%s
" "$o" | head -n 1 | cut -c1-11) blocks=$(printf "%s
" "$o" | grep -c "^mean_blocks_per_request=[0-9.]*$") fragmentation=$(printf "%s
" "$o" | grep -c "^paged_fragmentation_pct=[0-9.]*$")"'

checks.describe: the decode bound prints one line per accelerator, every one ending (estimate), and 219.9 for the H100 SXM row
checks.run:
sh -c 'o=$(bash m2/decode-bound.sh m2/inputs/models/qwen2.5-7b-instruct.conf | sed -n "/^RESULTS/,\$p" | sed 1d); n=$(printf "%s
" "$o" | grep -c .); e=$(printf "%s
" "$o" | grep -c "(estimate)$"); h=$(printf "%s
" "$o" | grep "^h100_sxm" | grep -c "= *219\.9 tokens/s (estimate)$"); echo "lines=$n estimates=$e h100=$h"'

checks.describe: every decode-bound line, for the 7B and the 72B model, prints a bandwidth, a weight size and a bound that agree: dividing the two printed operands and rounding to one decimal gives the printed bound
checks.run: for m in qwen2.5-7b-instruct qwen2.5-72b-instruct; do bash m2/decode-bound.sh m2/inputs/models/$m.conf | sed -n '/^RESULTS/,$p' | sed 1d; done | awk '{ for (j = 1; j <= NF; j++) if ($j == "GB/s") break; if ($(j+1) != "/" || $(j+3) != "GB" || $(j+4) != "=") { bad++; next } n++; if (sprintf("%.1f", $(j-1) / $(j+2)) == $(j+5)) ok++ } END { printf "rows=%d consistent=%d malformed=%d\n", n, ok, bad + 0 }'

checks.describe: the all-reduce calculator exits 0, prints the assumptions header and one time per link class
checks.run: sh -c 'o=$(bash m2/allreduce.sh m2/inputs/interconnect.conf); echo "first=$(printf "%s\n" "$o" | head -n 1 | cut -c1-11) times=$(printf "%s\n" "$o" | grep -c "time_s=[0-9.]* (estimate)$")"'
